title: First-coordinate slice
statement: For a function $f:\\mathbb F_2^{n+1}\\to\\mathbb F_2$ and $b\\in\\mathbb F_2$, define its slice at first coordinate $b$ to be the function on $\\mathbb F_2^n$ sending $x$ to $f(b,x)$.
hypotheses_covered: A function on the $(n+1)$-dimensional binary cube
